name: Mei Lindqvist
headline: Site Reliability Engineer
summary: SRE and software engineer focused on reliable cloud platforms, deployment automation, and operational improvement. Experience spans Python development, infrastructure as code, and service ownership across multi-team environments. Known for building practical systems that improve delivery speed, stability, and incident response.

roles.title: Junior Software Developer
bullets: Built internal tools in Python and GCP to streamline environment setup and reduce manual work for the engineering team by 35%.
Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and GitHub Actions, cutting release preparation time from hours to minutes.
Improved deployment consistency by standardizing cloud configurations and adding automated checks across the delivery pipeline.
Supported application maintenance and small feature work while keeping code changes reviewable and easy to trace.

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
bullets: Helped run production services on AWS and Azure, resolving incidents faster and improving platform uptime by 18%.

Used Kubernetes and Rust to stabilize service deployments and reduce memory-related failures by 22%.

roles.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

Develop platform utilities in Go and Bash to support day-to-day operations, environment management, and developer self-service.
Coordinate MLOps workflows with application teams so model rollouts stay repeatable and traceable across environments.
Package workloads with Docker and tune deployment standards to keep clusters efficient as usage grows.
